Name: Starfox Tricky Dog Replacer
Author: redscout101
Description:
(Keep in mind this is my first mod) 

This mod adds in Prince Tricky from the game Starfox Adventures into Stardew Valley as a dog.

I am well aware as of now that there is something weird going on with his shadow and i plan on fixing that soon.

If there's any other requests/bugs to be addressed please let me know.

This was originally just meant for me to use but I decided "ehh, why not?"
